'''Rulebooks''' are the rules documents for ''Star Wars'' CCG across every era this wiki covers. Decipher published rule booklets, a Glossary, a Glossary Supplement, and expansion rulesheets. The [[Players Committee]] later published a 2003 Rules Supplement, Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1 for [[Virtual Original]], Advanced Rulebook 2.0 for [[Virtual Legacy]], and the current Advanced Rulebook for [[Virtual Modern]] play.

'''This wiki supports playing all eras''' - Decipher constructed, Original Virtual, Legacy Virtual (pre-2014 Reset), and current Virtual / Players Committee tournament play. Use the chronological bands below to pick the rules document that matches the cards and format you are playing.

The tables below link each document's wiki transcription and PDF.<ref name="dec-index">[https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/index.html Star Wars CCG rules index] at Decipher.com (archive, 21 December 2008)</ref><ref name="pc-rules">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/rules/ Star Wars CCG Rules] at the Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021120438/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/rules.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1. Decipher ==

Core printed rules and expansion rulesheets from Decipher (1995-2001). No Players Committee modifications.<ref name="dec-index" />

=== Decipher rules before Special Edition (1995–1998) ===

Decipher's first rules came in two booklets: a small rulebook in the [[Premiere Limited]] starter decks and a larger rulebook in the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]]. Decipher's 1996 FAQ gave page numbers from both.<ref name="faq96-intro">[https://web.archive.org/web/19961219031209/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/faqs/introduction.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game: FAQs – Introduction to the FAQ], Decipher.com (archive, 19 December 1996)</ref> Each expansion from [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] to [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] added a rules supplement. In 1998 Decipher described the rules booklet of [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game]] as containing all the Premiere rules and being the most up-to-date version of them.<ref name="dec-rules-1998">[https://web.archive.org/web/19980506111511/http://decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/rules/ Star Wars Customizable Card Game: Rules], Decipher.com (archive, 6 May 1998)</ref><ref name="dec-rules-1996">[https://web.archive.org/web/19961219010259/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/rules/index.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game: Rules], Decipher.com (archive, 19 December 1996)</ref> Rulebook 2.0 and Glossary 2.0 (November 1998) replaced all of these documents.

=== Decipher FAQs, Current Rulings and errata ===

Decipher answered rules questions in FAQs and then in Current Rulings documents. The Rebel Leaders [[Kendrick Summers]] and [[Allen Divers]] and the Rebel Base Leader [[Tom Lischke]] made the rulings in the April 1998 Current Rulings.<ref name="dec-faq-1998">[https://web.archive.org/web/19980506104211/http://decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/faqs/ Star Wars Customizable Card Game: FAQs], Decipher.com (archive, 6 May 1998)</ref> From November 1998 each Current Rulings document was an official supplement to Glossary 2.0.<ref name="cr990610">[https://web.archive.org/web/19990914224031/http://www1.decipher.com/starwars/rules/currentrulings061099.pdf Current Rulings: Supplement to the Glossary – 10th June 1999], Decipher (archive, 14 September 1999)</ref>

== 2. Original Virtual ==

Era hub: [[Virtual Original]]. Set index: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]].

From 2002 the Players Committee layered rulings on the Decipher core books. The January 2003 Rules Supplement is that early layer. [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]] (PDF dated 6 July 2007) then replaced previous rulebooks. The Players Committee rules page still linked AR1.7.1.pdf in July and September 2009, at the [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]].<ref name="pcrules2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102757/http://www.starwarsccg.org/rules/ Rules], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 6 July 2009)</ref>

== 3. Legacy Virtual ==

Era hub: [[Virtual Legacy]]. Set index: [[Virtual Blocks (2009-2014)]].

Players Committee rules used with '''Virtual Legacy''' cards (2009 through the 2014 Reset). These are '''not''' Decipher publications and are '''not''' the current tournament Advanced Rulebook.

{| class="wikitable"
! Document
! Wiki
! PDF
|-
| Advanced Rulebook 2.0 (Legacy Virtual era)
| [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]] (redirect: [[Legacy Virtual Advanced Rulebook]])
| [[File:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf]] - also [https://web.archive.org/web/20150807023558/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf Wayback archive]
|}

AR 2.0 introduced the [[Mission]] card type and other Virtual Legacy-era revisions.<ref name="ar20">[https://web.archive.org/web/20150807023558/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf Advanced Rulebook 2.0] (Wayback)</ref> Use it when playing or researching pre-Reset PC virtual cards. Do '''not''' use it as a substitute for the 2023 Advanced Rulebook in current tournament play.
